analyst_view.overall: Sunderland (11th, 7 pts) host Jagiellonia (29th, 3 pts) needing a win to stay in the play-off places, but Régis Le Bris's side also host Tottenham three days later, so changes are likely. Le Bris confirmed before the Villa game that Granit Xhaka (calf) and Brian Brobbey (thigh) were out, along with Romaine Mundle (knee), Daniel Ballard and Habib Diarra (thighs); the numbers now count Brobbey (about -23% on Sunderland's goals) and Diarra, but not Xhaka's effect on the midfield or rotation. Jagiellonia have one European win, lost at Cracovia on Saturday, and their fans are barred from travelling by UEFA (Flashscore); one earlier report also had captain Taras Romanczuk suspended. No referee is named yet. Because Brobbey is now in the numbers, my trims are smaller than in the last view and rest on rotation and Xhaka.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals, 1.6 for Sunderland, and already take about 23% off for Brobbey and 4% for Diarra, plus a little for their poor scoring (3 goals in 6). They don't see Xhaka missing from midfield or a likely rotated side before Spurs, so I trim slightly, to about 2.1.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.6 corners, 7.2 for Sunderland, already a little lower for recent form. A rotated home side without Xhaka's passing should still dominate the ball against Jagiellonia, so I trim only slightly, to about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4.1 cards and already raise both sides for card-heavy runs (+7% and +8%). With no travelling Jagiellonia fans the atmosphere should be calmer, and one earlier report had their combative captain Romanczuk suspended (I could not confirm it again); no referee is named, so I trim a little, to about 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers expect 28.6 shots, 21.3 for Sunderland, and add 8% for their busy recent shooting. Brobbey is already counted, but with Xhaka out and changes likely before Tottenham I expect a little less volume, about 27.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers expect 9.9 shots on target, 7.4 for Sunderland. They already count Brobbey's absence for goals, and Sunderland have struggled to turn chances into goals; a rotated side without Xhaka's delivery adds a little more doubt, so I go to about 9.6.
